units.source_text: 这种思绪搅得我苦恼万分，我无法在这里继续呆下去了。

en.t: These thoughts tormented me so deeply that I could no longer stay here.

units.source_text: 但是，一种好奇心又把我拽住了。

en.t: But a kind of curiosity held me back again.

units.source_text: 我甚至以为这女子是有为子的转世，

en.t: I even thought that this woman was Uiko reincarnated,

units.source_text: 如今我望眼欲穿地期待着她作为被一个残疾学生所抛弃的女人而出现。

en.t: and now I waited with desperate longing for her to appear as a woman abandoned by a disabled student.

units.source_text: 不知什么时候，我竟袒护柏木，

en.t: Before I knew it, I was even defending Kashiwagi,

units.source_text: 沉浸在一种似是用自我来法污自己的回忆的错觉之喜悦中。

en.t: immersed in the delight of a delusion, as though I were using my own self to defile my memories of myself.
